result.title: SegAnyFruit: Learning Generalizable and Edge Deployable Fruit Instance Segmentation at Scale
result.summary: Deploying fruit instance segmentation in real agricultural settings requires generalizing across unseen species, orchards, and imaging conditions under strict onboard compute and annotation budgets. We introduce SegAnyFruit (SAF), a data construction and progressive training framework that distills foundation-model priors into lightweight, prompt-free segmenters. SAF combines generic mask pre-training, broad mid-training on automatically annotated web imagery from our curated WebFruits dataset, and human-verified agricultural refinement post-training on PaperFruits, together spanning 733K images and 9.66M whole-fruit masks across 165 fruit types. Across seven benchmarks, zero-shot SAF-RF-DETR-XL reaches 69.06 average mask AP50:95 (+4.76 over SAM 3) while remaining deployable on edge devices. SAF initialization also boosts few-shot to full-shot adaptation across five agricultural domains while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Finally, we systematically analyze training stages, data scale, model capacity, and generative augmentation, and validate our pipeline's transferability to underwater, cell, and human segmentation. We will release our datasets, code, and SAF models.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 SegAnyFruit，一个数据构建与分阶段训练框架，通过通用掩码预训练、网络图像中训练和人工校验的农业后训练，把基础模型的先验蒸馏进轻量、免提示的实例分割器，并在多基准与边缘部署上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把大模型视觉先验蒸馏到小模型且免提示」的做法，可供核查视觉细节在压缩后保留多少、以及渐进式训练是否缓解信息坍缩与遗忘，与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选和状态容量问题或许有间接联系。
